def emission_credit(row_map):
    observed_call = row_map["plume_detected"]
    panel_value = row_map["panel_venting_flag"]
    match_flag = int(observed_call == panel_value)
    return per_pad_credit * match_flag

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: To falsify a no-issue verdict I searched the workflow for any transformation of panel_venting_flag (subtraction from 1, boolean negation, XOR, remapping) and found none; the panel value flows untouched from the CSV into the equality test. I then recounted agreement by hand from all 24 staged rows under the supplied coding and obtained 19/24, matching both the reported rate and the reported emission total (19 x 2 = 38). I also checked whether the complemented coding could coincidentally reproduce these numbers: the complemented count would be 5/24 and emission 10.000 kg/h, which the report does not contain. All checks confirm the panel was used as supplied.
